label: def:local-public-strategy
hypotheses: d,b are natural numbers; queries return one bit and depend only on their declared original-row support.

The selected strategy halts and every receiver correctly decodes its transposed row on every input in the declared finite family F; no requirement outside F.
prose_scope: Exact original-row public strategy model with arbitrary finite query supports, helper selection, public stopping and own-original-row side information.

Additional immediately adjacent formal call(s) cover the other definitions or closure lemmas, recorded in proof_sources.

final_english_lean_comparison: LocalQuery support/read/locality and PublicStrategy List Bool -> Option LocalQuery match. Executes requires none at terminal history and transmits only query answers. label: thm:local-adaptive-separator
hypotheses: The complete public strategy, execution and decoding hypotheses of def:local-public-strategy.
A nonnegative probability law w on F, summing to one; zero masses allowed.
An arbitrary separator S(z,m) depending only on the helper and completed transcript.
prose_scope: E|M| >= P - E[d*b*|S| + b*sum_C |C|^2] - 2*(P-H(X)) - 2*H(Z), plus the uniform-input specialization. Components are those of the actual support-clique interaction graph outside S.
review_notes: Correctness is required on all of F, including zero-mass inputs. Virtual fibers fix the helper as a protocol parameter and need not equal actual helper fibers.
The proof outline preserves both conditional budgets and the correlated correct-family distinction; it does not assert rectangle factorization of F.
This is a finite restricted-model contribution related to the first paper construction heuristic, not a strengthened native pass lower bound.
program_role: Excludes a fixed fractional broadcast saving when expected separator loss, input deficit and helper entropy are all negligible relative to P.
final_english_lean_comparison: Matches graph_expected_separator_bound_of_distribution and its uniform specialization exactly: arbitrary normalized nonnegative law, all-F execution/correctness, arbitrary leaf-dependent separators, loss d*b*|S|+b*sum|C|^2, charges 2D_w and 2H(Z).
final_outline_assessment: Finite-family truncation, nonempty virtual-fiber component factorization, correct-subfamily entropy cover, and two conditional Gibbs budgets follow ProtocolTruncation, AdaptiveLeaves, SeparatorLeaf/Count, AdaptiveSeparator and EntropyFibers. Attained-leaf nonemptiness and fixed separator columns are now explicit.

label: cor:local-separator-worst
hypotheses: The public strategy hypotheses with nonempty F and finite ambient helper alphabet.
Natural B,L,g; every cost <= B, every graph separator loss <= L, and the attained helper image has size <= 2^g.
prose_scope: B >= P-L-2*(P-log_2|F|+g). Only helper values attained on F are charged.
review_notes: The finite ambient helper requirement is retained even though the entropy/count term uses only the attained range.
program_role: Converts the separator inequality to a candidate rejection test from pointwise broadcast/loss bounds and the attained helper range.
final_english_lean_comparison: Matches graph_worst_case_separator_bound: natural B,L,g, nonempty F, finite ambient helper, attained-image cardinal <=2^g, and exact B >= P-L-2(D+g).
final_outline_assessment: Uniform-law averaging and entropy <= logarithm of attained support are exactly the formal argument.

label: thm:local-separator-sharpness

final_english_lean_comparison: Both coefficient endpoints quantify over real c and arbitrary positive b for d=2. Zero-message symmetry family has deficit b; full-cube XOR-helper example has helper entropy b. No simultaneous optimality of all other terms is claimed.
final_outline_assessment: Read both explicit RowCode constructions, their correctness proofs, cardinality lemmas, and exact helper-entropy lemma. Outline describes the same witnesses; direct substitution forces c>=2.

label: lem:local-treewidth-fragmentation

label: def:local-triangular-causal

Natural r with r<=d.

Middle rows outside I plus raw R-by-J rectangle recover all raw rows in R, then all middle rows by inverse block injectivity, then input by correct transpose output. No extra block property is imposed.

label: thm:local-helper-count
hypotheses: A TwoStageHelper architecture correct on F, with arbitrary ambient helper type.

For the density corollary: D real, g natural, |F|>=2^(P-D), |z(F)|<=2^g.
prose_scope: |F|*2^(b*r*(d-r)) <= |z(F)|*2^P; taking r=floor(d/2) gives toll b*floor(d^2/4), and the density corollary gives D+g at least this toll.

final_outline_assessment: Partition into attained-helper fibers, apply branch count, multiply by exact exponent complement, and optimize at floor(d/2). Density premise implies nonempty F before logs. Full-cube consequence follows by cancelling 2^P.

Complementary restricted-architecture realization of the first paper hint issue, not general hint removal.
